scope: AC1018/AC1024 2D/3D ordinary paper-space and ordinary named-block POLYLINE membership with implicit or matching owner. Active named owner must have OrdinaryBlock kind. Nonmatching owner/space, PaperLayout, mesh/polyface and other revisions retain prior path; GROUP references to these children now fail closed; the old duplicate block membership could previously admit those unqualified targets.
authority: ODA v5.4.1 §§20.4.16–17 and 20.4.52: POLYLINE owns VERTEX/SEQEND; BLOCK_HEADER owns direct entities. The source controls establish selected per-owner topology.
implementation: Extend the existing exact-child one-shot permit and full guarded compound checkpoint to two new owner scopes for AC1018/AC1024; keep AC1021 GROUP qualification model-only. Source patch touches only src/libdwgr.cpp. Compatibility narrowing: previously indexed paper/named VERTEX and SEQEND targets may have been admitted by GROUP; removal of their duplicate block membership makes those unqualified references fail closed.
producer: ezdxf 1.4.5 authored R2007 scratch DXFs using tools/author_ac1021_polyline_owner_scopes.py; ODA 27.1.0 produced AC1018 and AC1024 DWGs, then AC1027 DXFs. Source graph independently checked via LibreDWG 0.14 and source DXF via ezdxf.
output: Scratch writer built from bbfa9890 and the candidate patch; output includes default plotstyle graph and, for AC1024, default material graph. ODA converted to AC1027 DXF. The 8-way audit verifies block order, parent/child owner and role, exact 2D/3D coordinates, and compares baseline/candidate entity records. Baseline ODA DXFs contain two zero vertices while candidate and source preserve all three.

validation.asan: 2/2 focused CTests passed with AppleClang 21 address sanitizer
validation.faults: Implicit/explicit owner, 2D/3D, SEQEND failure, early/late allocation exceptions, caller state, raw EED, destination sentinel and same-facade retry; reciprocal paper/named GROUP child refusal and parent target native readback retry; conflicting owner/space and PaperLayout unchanged.
validation.audit: PYTHONPATH=tools build/rpp5gh-evidence/peer/bin/python -O /private/tmp/polyline-owner-cross/audit_all.py: 8/8 source/baseline/candidate comparisons; audit_tests.py: five synthetic graph-corruption rejections.
validation.oda: Four source conversion batches plus two baseline and two candidate batches exited 0 with no .err and zero-byte captured logs. Local conversion lineage is observed separately and not proven by hashes.
validation.portable_audit: The repository-relative portable audit ran all 8 physical sources and 8 candidate pairs; optional baseline comparison checks silent two-zero-vertex loss and identical decoded entity frames. The source producer and audit use only CLI-supplied paths and hashes. The fixture-free negative test rejects five graph corruptions under Python and -O.
validation.integrated: The integrated candidate passed six focused CTests covering both new scopes, GROUP refusal, prior model and AC1021 paths, and following-entity facade readback. Both new scoped tests passed under AddressSanitizer, 2/2.

limits: The eight selected samples are not general AC1018/AC1024 support or proof of native application semantics.
Plotstyle/material settings are recorded as enabled for selected outputs and are not claimed universally necessary.
AC1027/AC1032 and GROUP→child closure remain unqualified; no external fixtures added.
Physical DWG/DXF witnesses remain scratch-only; no fixtures were added.
reproduction: Compile tools/probe_polyline_cross_scope.cpp against the candidate libdxfrw. Run MODE AC1018|AC1024 OUTPUT.dwg; modes paper2d,paper3d,named2d,named3d.
Use tools/author_ac1021_polyline_owner_scopes.py to author producer controls. Convert via ODA 27.1 ACAD2004/ACAD2010 DWG and ACAD2013 DXF, with audit enabled.

Run tools/audit_polyline_cross_scope_peer.py --version VERSION --mode MODE --dwgread READER --dwg CANDIDATE --dwg-sha256 SHA --dxf ODA_DXF --dxf-sha256 SHA; for candidate comparison also supply --baseline-dwg, --baseline-dwg-sha256, --baseline-dxf and --baseline-dxf-sha256.
